mood.final.curiosity.note: Range pin, not a point pin (#173). MockProvider's text always contains the configured value 'curiosity', so the curiosity trigger fires on every cycle and the dimension climbs geometrically from its 0.7 baseline toward the equilibrium initial + drift_rate/homeostasis_rate = 0.7 + 0.05/0.3 = 0.8666..., which it reaches only asymptotically. max is that equilibrium; min is the value after exactly six triggered cycles, which is the floor the manifest's own 'event_counts.thought >= 6' criterion guarantees. A run that completes hundreds of cycles lands at the top of the band; a slow host that completes seven lands near the bottom. Both are correct.
